scope: Independent review of Arithmetic adapter changes and binder; no reimplementation, no cloud actions, no Lean/kernel replay, no authorization to claim proof acceptance.

coverage.basis: Requires exact fixed predecessor paths and pins for workflow, driver, config, RUN, SUCCESS, index, archive and object. Authenticates every workflow member, unique normalized relative paths, required driver/config/audit; rejects extra Python, bytecode, shared libraries and symlinks before executing predecessor code. Driver/config pins must also equal the workflow rows.

Executes the same cached driver bytes that passed their hash check. The isolated child can select only the original Gaps verify CLI and original workflow SHA. Requires RETAINED_EVIDENCE_VERIFIED, 1 target/3 checks, zero old commands, false P2.6 and exact output artifact pins. No old module constants or original validators are patched.

Requires old Gaps schema, fixed stage, reviewed workflow SHA, 128 old dependencies, exact target module, 1/3 SUCCESS, 128/129 counts, ordered normal/kernel/owned records, original RUN pin and actual exact non-substituted Gaps object.

Authenticates 10 original payloads plus TRANSPORT; original MANIFEST row equality, AUDIT/RUNTIME, one exact module, no sidecars or project imports, original closure pointers and both original result/log chains. Original argv/cwd/external LEAN_PATH, unchanged before/after, source/object and empty project dependencies are checked. No extra old owned or explicit old trust-zero requirement is introduced.

Keeps original runtime files and current/original guard, recovery certificate and history from real Gaps RUN. Current Gaps verify recursively invokes its unchanged Shape/recovery checks each time. This layer does not refresh an old guard or invent historical loaded inventory.

Imports exactly Gaps and FastDet. Traverses the fixed sources to require 130 distinct suppliers, excluding the new owner; creates ordinary separate source/object copies, rejects hard links and missing established copies, permits no project fallback under external roots. Environment changes only its first object namespace.

New normal and owned preserve explicit trust=0, warningAsError, one thread, memory and heartbeat flags. Kernel is the pinned stock checker replay of the same module/object. Exact command reconstruction, raw log/result, metrics, prior acceptance and same object are required.

Uses actual complete serialized/environment inventory via the unchanged strict original parser; full types and transitive axioms limited to the three standard axioms. Fifteen explicit source prints are bound uniquely to actual public/private owned names, not used as the owned count. Generated declarations remain included.

Fsyncs exclusive RUN/command/launch-witness before spawn; partial or non-prefix evidence, suffix loss with surviving witness, missing objects, orphan inventories and STOPPED reject replay. Failure result/log and durable launch evidence remain intact.

Verify requires retained artifacts and opens the existing execution lock read-only; it does not repair missing copies, directories, summaries or archives. Export contains all new command/result/log/seals/witnesses, new source/object/audit, workflow, FastDet capsule and full nested Gaps archive plus fixed references.

Success claims one new owner/three new checks, 130 old suppliers and closure131; exactly56 complete finite RowDataChecksFor rows, reusing clauses3/5 and adding1/2/4/6/7/8/9/10. Zero new global Archive-bound rows; P2.6 false. This aligns with all_bounded_row_data_checks/all_raw_row_data_checks in the reviewed source.

checks: The independently supplied retained-report SHA authenticates the exact retained JSON before using its success status or artifact pins.
The report archive pin binds exact archive bytes and the workflow digest independently binds the complete original Gaps workflow.
Every archive member must be regular, unique and relative without traversal; workflow payload bytes must match their pinned rows.
Original retained SUCCESS/index pins must equal the actual archive bodies; SUCCESS RUN/object must equal actual archived RUN/object and ordered1/3 records with128/129 counts.
No CONFIG or workflow manifest exists in the candidate. The binder creates exclusive outputs, permits identical existing bodies and refuses conflicting ones.
New source/audit/FastDet pins are fixed, and the final manifest pins the actual new package payloads. The final generated manifest is a separate deployment trust anchor to review after real binding.
binder_assessment.trust_boundary: The binder authenticates a report using the external SHA supplied by root; it is not an offline replacement for Gaps receipt verification. Production arithmetic must successfully call the unchanged live Gaps verify before any new proof command, so a report label alone cannot authorize compilation. Preserve the actual retained report, its independently obtained SHA and binder command/output alongside the release evidence.

remaining_gates: Actual Gaps normal/kernel/owned acceptance and independent retained readback.

Run the reviewed binder only with that exact retained report, report SHA, archive and reviewed Gaps workflow SHA; independently read back the resulting CONFIG/workflow manifest and candidate payload pins.
Deploy the exact bound package and run its no-proof preflight, then only the three new Arithmetic checks and independent readback.
